title: The Road Trip of Affliction
physical_identity: Deserted infinite highway between tall weathered concrete walls in thick fog and darkness; players wake in a car, the only safe place.
scale_topology: Infinite; outdoor road with side walls; flat; no vertical structure.
anomalies: hidden Fragment of Destivinatia under every car repels fog and entities
lighting_sound: Only self-produced light; fog; sound not stated.

entities.name: Wretches
entities.behavior: extremely rare, may break into parked cars

entities.name: The Beings From Above
entities.behavior: leg-like appendages descend when you leave the car; unkillable

entities.name: The Whispers
entities.behavior: shared intrusive thoughts, not confirmed entity

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers, Wretches, Beings From Above, The Whispers
hazards: car breakdown or fire after tunnel

entrances.method: Enter odd car in octagonal room; vanish 7 s after unconsciousness
entrances.quote: the car and anyone inside will disappear from Level 3 without a trace
fall through the floor as if it were not there
6 reports of people vanishing to Level 69 immediately after drinking Almond Water

exits.method: Perpendicular tunnel, drive about 17 hours, then walk
exits.conditions: find tunnel; car fails at 17 h; do not re-enter
exits.risk: car fire if driven when dead

exits.quote: you will appear in Level 22 with your car parked in a parking space
it is only a rumor for now

signature_mechanic: The car is a moving safe bubble in fog; leaving it summons the Beings From Above. Long safe driving finds a tunnel exit.
conflicts_notes: Page creator differs from cite authors (Kaixo). Intro says 'stay in the car or perish' while the body allows leaving near the car.

key_quotes.quote: A deserted, infinite highway shrouded in thick fog and pitch darkness
Cars are the only place you will be free from entities and fog.
the cars in this level do not require any
many will swiftly and silently descend from the darkness above
you must drive through the tunnel for approximately 17 hours
